correctness.rationale: For a fixed binary configuration, independently count valid thresholds via the closed-neighborhood test; this yields the exact double sum. Divide by the two binomial normalizers to obtain a Markov trace. Factorial moments triangularize the two-stage operator in the monomial basis, proving all eigenvalues including zeros. A Gaussian majorant proves the sharp square-root asymptotic for min(a,b) tending to infinity. Actual checker exhausts four small graph cases and tests the rational identity for 49 parameter pairs. No finite tests are mistaken for the infinite proof.
